title: 第七章 收回别墅第八章 救人第九章 误会
lines: 第七章收回别墅
叶欢这么上道，叶临峰很高兴，也不想啰嗦，哈哈笑道：“那好，你们快点收拾，周一我就要搬进来了。”
叶临峰走之前还看了墨青语一眼，这女人实在漂亮，可惜了，跟了叶欢这么一个傻子。
看到叶欢就这么把别墅让了出去，墨青语心里没有丝毫失落。
她本来就讨厌叶家，仗着有钱势力大，让她父亲逼着她嫁给了叶欢。
自然，墨青语也不稀罕住叶家这么一栋别墅。
这是叶家的财产，他不是原来的叶欢，自然也不想和叶家有什么牵连，这房子正好还给他们。
墨青语看了叶欢一眼，说道：“房子他们收回去就收回去吧，我去买面租个房子，也够我们住了。”
“你不用管我，正好，我们把这个事情解决了。”叶欢说道。
“解决什么事情？”墨青语一愣。
“我们离婚吧。”叶欢平静地说道。
“啊？”墨青语一时没有反应过来。
“我是说，现在房子也没了，我们正好去把婚离了。之前是我对不起你，仗着家里的势力才娶了你，差点害了你一辈子，还好我之前身子不行，一直没对你做出什么，你也还是清白身子……”
“我知道，你嫁给我一定很痛苦吧。我现在也没什么好补偿你的，就先把婚离了吧，也算报答你一部分了。”
墨青语愣住了。
离婚？
他说离婚？
这正是墨青语长期以来乞求的啊！可是现在叶欢说出这句话，墨青语心头也不知道是什么滋味，奇怪得很。
“怎么了？”叶欢问道。
“没事，没事，能离婚实在太好了！今天可能有些晚了，那就明天去吧。对了，周末民政局好像也不上班，那就星期一吧……”墨青语急急忙忙地说道，还给了叶欢一个有些勉强的笑容。
叶欢本来想提醒一下墨青语，现在只是中午，赶去民政局离婚还来得及。
但看到墨青语的笑容，叶欢还是忍住了，反正他也不着急，什么时候去离婚都一样，只是为了还墨青语一个自由身而已。
“好吧，那就下周一吧，我先去做饭了，吃了这顿饭再收拾东西离开吧。”叶欢说着从怀里掏出了一个信封，“这里面有3000块钱，是还你上次借我的2000，还有1000利息。”
墨青语愣愣地接过信封，他没想到叶欢真的还钱给他了，难道他真的去赚钱了？他会干什么呢？
叶欢又进厨房了，墨青语看着叶欢高挑瘦弱的背影，一时间心思百转千回。
她觉得叶欢不一样了，越来越正常了，不仅会做饭给自己吃，还会赚钱了。
看叶欢有些瘦弱的身影，墨青语还真有些可怜他，好在他现在能赚钱了，应该饿不死。
不管如何，终于要和叶欢离婚了，她要开始一个全新的生活了。
叶欢做好了饭，六菜一汤，很丰盛。
果然，叶欢做的饭菜还是这么好吃，本来墨青语的心情复杂，没什么胃口，但叶欢做的饭菜还是让她忍不住大吃了一顿。
吃过饭，两人各自回房间收拾东西。
叶欢的东西很简单，两件换洗的衣物，放在他的帆布包里就行了。
“墨青语，那我先走了。”收拾好东西，叶欢朝着楼上喊到。
“等一下。”墨青语连忙小跑了下来，递给了叶欢一张银行卡。
“这是我找我表妹小开借的十万块钱，本来是想就给你治病的，现在你好了，就把这个钱给你吧，密码是123456。”

Chapter 7 Taking Back the Villa
Ye Huan was so kind. Ye Linfeng was very happy and didn't want to be verbose. He laughed and said, "Okay, hurry up and pack up. I will move in on Monday."
Before Ye Linfeng left, he glanced at Mo Qingyu. This woman was really beautiful. It was a pity that she followed a fool like Ye Huan.
Seeing Ye Huan give up the villa just like that, Mo Qingyu didn't feel disappointed at all.
She originally hated the Ye family, so her father forced her to marry Ye Huan because of her wealth and power.
Naturally, Mo Qingyu was not interested in living in a villa like the Ye family.
This is the property of the Ye family. He is not the original Ye Huan, so naturally he does not want to have anything to do with the Ye family. This house will just be returned to them.
Mo Qingyu glanced at Ye Huan and said, "If they take back the house, they can take it back. I'll buy a house and rent a house. It's enough for us to live in."
"You don't need to worry about me. Just in time, we have solved this matter." Ye Huan said.
"What problem should be solved?" Mo Qingyu was stunned.
"Let's get a divorce." Ye Huan said calmly.
"Ah?" Mo Qingyu didn't react for a moment.
"I mean, now that the house is gone, we just went to get a divorce. I was sorry for you before and relied on my family's power to marry you, which almost harmed you for the rest of your life. Fortunately, I was in poor health before and never did anything to you, and you are still innocent..."
"I know it must be painful for you to marry me. I have nothing to compensate you now, so I'll just divorce you first, which will be part of my repayment to you."
Mo Qingyu was stunned.
divorce?
He said divorce?
This is exactly what Mo Qingyu has been begging for for a long time! But now that Ye Huan said these words, Mo Qingyu didn't know what it felt like, it was very strange.
"What's wrong?" Ye Huan asked.
"It's okay, it's okay, it's great to get a divorce! It may be a bit late today, so let's go tomorrow. By the way, the Civil Affairs Bureau doesn't seem to be working on weekends, so let's do it on Monday..." Mo Qingyu said hurriedly, and gave Ye Huan a somewhat forced smile.
Ye Huan originally wanted to remind Mo Qingyu that it was only noon and it was not too late to rush to the Civil Affairs Bureau for a divorce.
But seeing Mo Qingyu's smile, Ye Huan still held back. He was not in a hurry anyway, it didn't matter when he got divorced, just to give Mo Qingyu his freedom.
"Okay, let's do it next Monday. I'm going to cook first. After eating this meal, we can pack up and leave." Ye Huan said and took out an envelope from his arms, "There is 3,000 yuan in it, to pay back the 2,000 you lent me last time, and there is 1,000 interest."
Mo Qingyu took the envelope blankly. He didn't expect that Ye Huan really paid him back. Did he really make money? What will he do?
Ye Huan entered the kitchen again. Mo Qingyu looked at Ye Huan's tall and thin back, and her mind was spinning a thousand times.
She felt that Ye Huan was different and became more and more normal. Not only could he cook for himself, but he could also make money.
Looking at Ye Huan's thin figure, Mo Qingyu felt a little pity for him. Fortunately, he could make money now, so he probably wouldn't starve to death.
No matter what, she was finally divorcing Ye Huan, and she was going to start a new life.
Ye Huan made a meal, six dishes and one soup, which was very rich.
Sure enough, the food cooked by Ye Huan was still so delicious. Mo Qingyu was in a complicated mood and had little appetite, but the food cooked by Ye Huan still made her unable to resist eating.
After eating, the two of them went back to their rooms to pack their things.
Ye Huan's things are very simple, just put two changes of clothes in his canvas bag.
"Mo Qingyu, I'm leaving first." After packing his things, Ye Huan called upstairs.
"Wait a minute." Mo Qingyu trotted down quickly and handed Ye Huan a bank card.
"This is 100,000 yuan that I borrowed from my cousin Xiaokai. I originally wanted to treat you. Now that you are better, I will give you this money. The password is 123456."
title_en: Chapter 7: Taking back the villa Chapter 8: Saving people Chapter 9: Misunderstanding
